_comment: WordPiece tokenizer.json pins (docs/algorithms/wordpiece.md section 1): the ten most-downloaded distinct wordpiece tokenizers of the census (census/coverage.json, (b) downloads) plus three extras. Anonymous hub downloads at a pinned revision, sha256 checked. Fetch: uv run tests/wordpiece/fetch.py Added 2026-10-04 (targets): the census's other eight wordpiece tokenizer.json files (every census wordpiece id but two: cambridgeltl/SapBERT-from-PubMedBERT-fulltext and YituTech/conv-bert-base ship only vocab.txt, which the census converted; toks reads tokenizer.json).

minilm-l6.why: #1 wordpiece tokenizer (22.05% of census (b) downloads): uncased BERT vocab 30522, truncation 128 + padding Fixed(128) pad_id 0 in the file; also all-MiniLM-L12-v2, Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, thenlper/gte-small, thenlper/gte-large

bert-uncased.why: #2 (18.78%): the bert-base-uncased config (vocab 30522, [CLS] 101 / [SEP] 102), no truncation / padding; 27 models incl. BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, bge-base/large-en-v1.5, nomic-embed-text-v1.5, ms-marco-MiniLM-L4/L12

mpnet.why: #3 (1.75%): RobertaProcessing <s>=0 </s>=2, <mask> lstrip + normalized special token, truncation 128 + Fixed(128) pad_id 1, vocab 30527

arctic-l.why: #4 (0.55%): truncation 512 + BatchLongest padding (a no-op for one sequence); byte-identical to datasocietyco/bge-base-en-v1.5-course-recommender-v5 (the census's most-downloaded holder)

bge-small-zh.why: #5 (0.41%): CASED (lowercase false, so no accent strip) chinese vocab 21128

text2vec-zh.why: #6 (0.25%): uncased chinese vocab 21128; the repo has the file under onnx/ only; same config as BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5, bge-base-zh-v1.5, shibing624/macbert4csc-base-chinese

labse.why: extra (0.06%): the largest wordpiece vocab in the census (501153), multilingual cased

ko-sroberta.why: extra (0.05%): korean cased vocab 32000, [CLS]=0 [SEP]=2 template, truncation 128 + BatchLongest pad_id 1

bert-base-uncased.why: extra: SPEC 1.1 (c) named family 'bert'; other bytes, same hf-normalized config as bert-uncased (3efa0e94a985)

qdrant-minilm-l6.why: census #12 wordpiece tokenizer (0.111% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 30522, truncation 256, padding BatchLongest, 5 added tokens

specter2.why: census #13 wordpiece tokenizer (0.095% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 31090, no truncation, 5 added tokens

pubmedbert.why: census #14 wordpiece tokenizer (0.091% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 30522, truncation 512, padding BatchLongest, 5 added tokens

jina-v2-small.why: census #15 wordpiece tokenizer (0.072% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 30528, no truncation, 5 added tokens

multiqa-minilm.why: census #16 wordpiece tokenizer (0.068% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 30522, truncation 250, padding Fixed(250), 5 added tokens

paraphrase-minilm-l3.why: census #17 wordpiece tokenizer (0.060% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 30522, truncation 128, padding BatchLongest, 5 added tokens

labse-setu.why: census #21 wordpiece tokenizer (0.046% of census (b) downloads): cased, vocab 501153, no truncation, 0 added tokens

msmarco-bert.why: census #22 wordpiece tokenizer (0.042% of census (b) downloads): lowercase, vocab 30522, truncation 300, padding BatchLongest, 5 added tokens
